title: Planning under Noise with Neural Operators
abstract: arXiv:2610.28623v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Planning under uncertain control execution noise requires reliable feedback policies across diverse environments. We introduce Planning Under Noise (PUN), a neural operator that learns noise-aware value fields for planning in unseen geometries. Building on an established screened-Poisson formulation of stochastic optimal control, we address two challenges: specifying boundary conditions that support navigation across varying geometries and efficiently computing fields with reliable gradients. Zero-Dirichlet obstacle boundaries terminate sampled paths at walls, weakening the goal signal along long routes and making it harder to estimate reliably. We instead impose reflecting Neumann conditions on obstacles and a Dirichlet condition at the goal, allowing sampled paths to continue exploring free space until they reach the target. To solve the resulting PDE without a configuration-space mesh, we extend a Monte Carlo (MC) solver, Walk on Star

translated_title: 基于神经算子的噪声环境规划
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.28623v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：在不确定的控制执行噪声下进行规划，需要在多样化环境中具备可靠的反馈策略。我们提出了“噪声下规划”神经算子（Planning Under Noise, PUN），它能够学习噪声感知的价值场，用于在未见过的几何环境中进行规划。基于已有的随机最优控制屏蔽泊松公式，我们解决了两个挑战：指定支持在不同几何环境中导航的边界条件，以及高效计算具有可靠梯度的价值场。零狄利克雷障碍物边界会在墙壁处终止采样路径，削弱沿长路径的目标信号，从而降低估计的可靠性。我们转而在障碍物上施加反射诺伊曼条件，并在目标处施加狄利克雷条件，使采样路径能够继续探索自由空间直至到达目标。为了在无需构型空间网格的情况下求解所得到的偏微分方程，我们扩展了蒙特卡洛求解器 Walk on Star……
tldr: 本文提出PUN神经算子，通过在屏蔽泊松随机最优控制框架中为障碍物引入反射诺伊曼边界条件、为目标引入狄利克雷条件，并结合网格无关的蒙特卡洛求解器，学习噪声感知的价值场，从而在未见过的几何环境中实现噪声下的可靠规划。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PUN, a neural operator that learns noise-aware value fields by imposing reflecting Neumann conditions on obstacles and Dirichlet conditions at the goal within the screened-Poisson stochastic optimal control framework, combined with a mesh-free Monte Carlo solver, enabling reliable planning under noise in unseen geometries.
